description: Eliminates channel data below a threshold amplitude, window by window - the noise gate of the spectral domain, keyed on per-channel level rather than overall signal level. threshold 0 is a byte-identical passthrough (verified). CALIBRATION MATTERS: the threshold compares against raw channel amplitudes, which sit far below full scale on real material - on a -14 dBFS probe, 0.01 barely bites (-14.1 dBFS out), 0.2 thins audibly (-18.8) and 0.5 renders silence. Static duration (1.9998 from a 2.023 s analysis, 1.5035 from 1.521 - marginally SHORTER than the usual round-trip, unlike most of the family). Deterministic. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Quick spectral cleanup and thinning with a single knob: low values strip analysis noise-floor and reverb haze; pushing higher hollows the sound out to its loudest components - a level-keyed cousin of hilite trace (which keeps a COUNT of channels rather than a level class). Because the useful range is source-dependent and small, sweep upward gently (0.001 -> 0.1) and listen; with a breakpoint file the gate becomes a spectral erosion envelope - ramp it up across the file and the sound progressively dissolves, keeping only its spectral skeleton. Pair with spec gain upstream to place material against the fixed threshold (gain 2 halves every effective threshold).

threshold.description: Channel-amplitude floor below which data is zeroed. CDP-enforced 0 to 1 ('-0.1'/'1.5' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[1] Value (...) out of range (0.000000 to 1.000000)'). 0 is a verified byte-identical passthrough. Useful values are typically well below 0.5 (channel amps are much smaller than full scale). May vary over time via breakpoint file (verified: a 0-to-0.5 ramp differs from both scalar-endpoint renders). Required positional (omission: 'Insufficient parameters on command line.').

examples.expected_use: Removes only the quietest channel data - de-hazing without changing the sound's identity.
Starts untouched and erodes toward the loudest components across the file.

known_issues: Threshold is an absolute channel-amplitude, not dB or percent-of-peak: on a -14 dBFS rich source, 0.5 already produced total silence at exit 0 - silence is a legal outcome, not an error. Calibrate low.
Output is marginally SHORTER than the input round-trip (1.9998 vs 2.0230 on the shared fixture) - still within the static model's tolerance, but note the family-atypical direction.
